summary: Proof ownership for the canonical content-addressed display-topology observation.

entries.contract: One frozen active-display observation canonically orders and hashes every declared mapping fact, drives explicit region and list projections without a second display observation, and remains separate from capture state and DesktopWorld lifecycle generations.
entries.worth: This catches identity instability, omitted rotation or bounds facts, unsafe UUID fallback, response drift, saved-region projection loss, and duplicate live display enumeration without requiring screen capture or TCC.
entries.guard: focused production Swift helper, deterministic JSON fixtures, static source guards, and fake-AOS saved-region projection only; no repo AOS binary, build, daemon, ScreenCaptureKit capture, GUI, TCC, or live display mutation
